# invoke

**In one sentence:** one small adapter per pipeline step that turns "run this step with this config" into the actual call to the step's code.

## Why it exists
The pipeline engine wants to call every step the same way:
`adapter(working_dir, output_dir, config, **kwargs)`. Each step's real `run()` takes different
arguments. These adapters bridge the gap, and also switch to a fake ("mock") runtime for UI smoke tests.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `import_step.py`, `upscale_step.py`, `quality_gate_step.py`, `curate_step.py`, `vae_gate_step.py`, `caption_bbox_step.py`, `caption_verifier_step.py`, `audit_step.py`, `bucket_pools_check_step.py`, `export_step.py` | `invoke_<step>` adapters: check preconditions, build a `StepRunContext` (report path, enabled substeps, cancel check, UI interaction) and call the step module's `run()`. |
| `working_dataset.py` | `_require_working_dataset` — fails with "Run ImportStep first" if `<output>/dataset` does not exist yet. |
| `mock_curate.py`, `mock_embeddings.py` | Fake Curate run with deterministic fake CLIP embeddings, for `--mock` UI runs. |
| `mock_vae_gate.py` | Fake VaeGate run (no real VAE model). |
| `mock_caption_verifier.py` | Fake CaptionVerifier run: a PIL colour plate stands in for the text-to-image model; everything else is the real code. |
| `__init__.py` | Builds `STEP_INVOKE_MAP` (step type -> adapter) and re-exports the adapters and mocks. |

## How it works
- The engine looks up `STEP_INVOKE_MAP[step.type]` and calls it with the working dataset folder, output folder, config, plus kwargs (`concept_token`, `original_dir`, `force`, `enabled_substeps`, `cancel_check`, ...).
- If kwargs contain `mock_runtime=True` (set by `prepare_lora_kit_ui/e2e/models.py` for `plk ui --mock`), Curate, VaeGate, CaptionBbox and CaptionVerifier use their mock instead of loading ML models.
- Heavy step modules are imported inside the adapter, so importing this package stays cheap.

## Who uses it
- `pipeline/execution/engine.py` — every pipeline run (CLI and UI).
- `cli/step/command.py` — the single-step command.
- `prepare_lora_kit_ui/runner/__init__.py`
- Tests: `tests/pipeline/`, `tests/steps/*/test_step.py`, `tests/ui/dev/`

## Good to know
- The CaptionBbox mock lives elsewhere, in `steps/caption_bbox/mock.py`, unlike the other mocks here.
